description: This is a FastAPI-based main application script for an IT Job Portal backend. It sets up API endpoints for health checks, user registration, and login, along with middleware configurations and database connection initialization.

methods.name: health_check()
methods.description: Health check endpoint that returns a simple message indicating the server is healthy.

methods.name: register_user(user_in: UserCreate, db: Session = Depends(get_db))
methods.description: API endpoint to register a new user with email, password, and role; ensures email uniqueness and stores the user in the database.

methods.name: login_user(form_data: UserCreate = Depends(), db: Session = Depends(get_db))
methods.description: API endpoint for user login that verifies credentials and returns a JWT token for authenticated sessions.

ctags.name: login_user
ctags.pattern: /^def login_user(form_data: UserCreate = Depends(), db: Session = Depends(get_db)):$/
